ov: برلنتي هو فيلم مصري تم إنتاجه عام 1944، قصة وإخراج يوسف وهبي و بطولة يوسف وهبي، نور الهدى.
plotEn: After the death Berlanti's father, she became depressed and her mother becomes ill, so Berlanti is forced to work as a singer so that she can be pay for her mother's treatment. The lawyer Sami marries her. Berlanti sees that she is standing in the way of Sami's success. She sacrifices her reputation so that he can leave her. He believes this and expels her and they got divorced. He marries the Samiha anfter and then Berlanti is accused of murder. And Samy steps up to defend her.
